name: scrape-harness
description: Gates, agents, runbooks and a monitor for a polite, typed scraping pipeline whose every rule is declared in the project's pipeline.toml: networked runs only with an operator-signed plan, no data in the repo, no secret on a command line, a task per declared stage, an incident record the run-steward agent cannot walk away from, and a plan-pipeline workflow that designs a pipeline without fetching anything.
